title: Harissa Tikka Roast Chicken
meta_description: Harissa tikka roast chicken: a French poulet rôti technique with Pakistani tikka spices and rose harissa. Halal, bold, and worth the overnight marinade.
og_title: Harissa Tikka Roast Chicken | French-Pakistani Fusion
og_description: A whole chicken dry-brined with tikka spices, yogurt, and rose harissa, then roasted French-style for crackling skin and deeply spiced meat. Halal and genuinely different.
